scope: Shared future economic outcome contract for the independently registered BUY and SELL ranked-toxicity exposure guards. This contract freezes labels and score semantics but grants no permission to read economic outcomes until the corresponding side mechanics gate passes.

primary_reward.fees: deduct exact causally convertible fees once; an unknown commission asset censors the affected economic record and may not be treated as USDC

toxic_fill_estimand.epsilon_provenance: economic break-even boundary after known maker fees; not fitted to Development outcomes
toxic_fill_estimand.future_price: normalized_l2_100ms_v2 BBO mid from the first valid grid snapshot at or after fill_ts_plus_10000ms and no later than target_plus_100ms
toxic_fill_estimand.missing_future_bbo: retain the assigned decision; mark the unmatched filled quantity unlabeled and use the conservative censoring bound
toxic_fill_estimand.partial_fill_rule: label every execution quantity separately before aggregating to its assigned decision
toxic_fill_estimand.assigned_quantity_rule: freeze assigned quantity at the randomized opportunity before downstream order and fill paths
toxic_fill_estimand.conservative_censoring_bound: candidate unlabeled fill quantity is toxic and baseline unlabeled fill quantity is non-toxic
